members.name: intents_flat
members.instructions: A customer of a digital bank sent this message to support chat. Which single intent best describes what the customer is asking about? Pick the most specific intent that matches the customer's main request.

criteria.activate_my_card: How to activate a card, or the customer cannot activate their card.
criteria.card_arrival: An ordered card has not arrived yet, or the customer wants to track the card that was sent.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, when it will arrive, express/fast delivery, delivery to a given place or by a date.
criteria.order_physical_card: How to order a physical card, fees for a physical card, ordering a card to a country.
criteria.get_physical_card: Getting the physical card itself, e.g. the PIN for a new physical card, how to get the physical card after opening an account.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional/second/spare card, cards for family members, how many cards one can have.
criteria.card_about_to_expire: The card is expiring or has expired; how to get a replacement/renewal for an expiring card.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard; wanting one or the other.
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the app/account, or making a received card show in the app; re-linking a found card.
criteria.change_pin: How to change or reset the card PIN.
criteria.pin_blocked: The PIN or card is blocked after entering the wrong PIN too many times; unblocking.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get a disposable (single-use) virtual card.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get or order a (non-disposable) virtual card; where is my virtual card.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits/restrictions of disposable virtual cards (how many times they can be used, how many disposable cards).
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: The virtual card is not working.
criteria.card_not_working: The card is not working / stopped working in general (not specifically a declined payment, contactless, or ATM).
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted / can be used (shops, merchants, abroad), or a merchant not accepting the card.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment was declined/rejected at a shop or online.
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM swallowed / kept / ate the card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The card was lost or stolen, or found again after being lost.
criteria.compromised_card: The customer thinks their card or card details were stolen/copied or that someone else may be using the card, and asks what to do or how to report fraud - without pointing to a specific payment or withdrawal (those go to the not-recognised intents).
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The customer's phone was lost, stolen or left behind and they need access/security.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Any message that mentions Apple Pay, Google Pay or Apple Watch, whatever the issue: adding the card, paying, topping up with them, top-up via them failing (this wins over every top-up or card intent).
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is still pending.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted, returned or sent back to the account, or a merchant refused/returned the payment after it was made.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A specific payment or purchase on the statement the customer does not recognise, did not make, or says is wrong (even if they also suspect someone has their card).
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: A fee or extra charge for paying with the card / for a purchase; hidden fees or too many fees on payments; 'why was I charged extra' about using the card.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: A payment got the wrong exchange rate; a complaint that the rate the customer got/was applied is incorrect (not about cash withdrawals).
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same transaction/payment was charged twice (duplicate charge).
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: A small fixed extra charge such as an extra £1, $1 or €1 (one pound/dollar/euro) on the statement, even if pending or unrecognised.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer did not set up, or a vague charge the customer does not know or calls unknown/unauthorised ('I don't know what this charge is for', 'unauthorised charge').
criteria.request_refund: How to request/get a refund for a purchase, or wants to cancel a purchase / no longer wants an item.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund the customer is waiting for has not shown up in the account.
criteria.atm_support: ATM questions: where to find an ATM, which ATMs accept the card, using the card at an ATM in general.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fees charged for withdrawing cash at an ATM.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A specific cash withdrawal on the account the customer did not make / does not recognise, even if they say someone has their card info or copied the card.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal at an ATM was declined/not authorised.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal shows as pending / in progress.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: An ATM gave the wrong amount of cash.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal.
criteria.automatic_top_up: The automatic (auto) top-up feature: does it exist, how to set it up, how it works, its limits.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is pending or taking long to complete.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up by bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees for topping up by card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up with cash or a cheque; how to deposit cash/cheques.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed, was declined, gave an error, or something seems wrong with a top-up so the money is not accessible.
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-up amounts or frequency; maximum top-up.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted, or money from a top-up was taken but the account was not credited / the money disappeared.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up / add money using a card (debit or credit), or transferring money with a credit card.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verification of a top-up or top-up card; the verification code for a top-up.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Cash or cheque that was deposited is not showing in the balance yet / a cheque deposit is taking long.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into the account / add money by bank transfer.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: The customer was told by a message that a transfer is not possible or not allowed (to a particular person or account, or though it usually works), or cannot add or use a beneficiary/payee.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel, stop, reverse or revert a transfer or transaction they made, or sent money to the wrong account. (Cancelling a purchase from a merchant is request_refund.)
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was explicitly declined (a decline message), e.g. despite having enough money; also when the customer says their 'transfers' keep being declined/denied, even if they mention a purchase.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed, did not go through, keeps failing or gives an error; the customer cannot make a transfer or is unable to transfer funds.
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer is pending / still in progress.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee was charged on a transfer; also a bare 'why was I charged (a fee)?' asking the reason for a charge with no other context.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: A transfer the customer sent to someone (person, retailer, landlord) has not reached them yet, including asking how much longer the recipient must wait.
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money / can someone send me money, salary into the account.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: A bank transfer (incoming or outgoing) has gone through or was made but the account balance has not updated / the money is not showing in the balance.
criteria.exchange_rate: What the exchange rates are, where to find them, how they are determined (a question, not a complaint about a wrong applied rate).
criteria.exchange_via_app: Whether and how the customer can exchange their money into another currency using the app (e.g. 'can I exchange some money to euros', 'change USD to GBP with the app').
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies are supported for holding or exchanging; whether a given currency (e.g. EUR) is supported or allowed.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, credit cards) or currencies can be used to top up / add money to the account.
criteria.country_support: Which countries the bank/service supports; whether people living in a given country or outside the UK can get the cards or use the service.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open/use an account; can children or teenagers have an account.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Change personal details: name, address, phone, email, account information.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode / login code; reset passcode.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity; what documents are needed; how long verification takes.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification is needed, whether it is really necessary, or whether the account can be used without verifying; why personal information is requested.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification failed or cannot be completed.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying / showing the source of funds (where money came from).

card_setup.instructions: Which specific intent in the area 'Getting, ordering, receiving, activating, linking or renewing a card; PIN; card type' best describes the customer's request?

criteria.activate_my_card: How to activate a card, or the customer cannot activate their card.
criteria.card_arrival: An ordered card has not arrived yet, or the customer wants to track the card that was sent.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, when it will arrive, express/fast delivery, delivery to a given place or by a date.
criteria.order_physical_card: How to order a physical card, fees for a physical card, ordering a card to a country.
criteria.get_physical_card: Getting the physical card itself, e.g. the PIN for a new physical card, how to get the physical card after opening an account.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional/second/spare card, cards for family members, how many cards one can have.

criteria.change_pin: How to change or reset the card PIN.
criteria.pin_blocked: The PIN or card is blocked after entering the wrong PIN too many times; unblocking.

virtual_cards.instructions: Which specific intent in the area 'Virtual and disposable virtual cards' best describes the customer's request?

criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get a disposable (single-use) virtual card.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get or order a (non-disposable) virtual card; where is my virtual card.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits/restrictions of disposable virtual cards (how many times they can be used, how many disposable cards).
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: The virtual card is not working.

card_problems.instructions: Which specific intent in the area 'Card not working, declined, lost, stolen, compromised, swallowed; where card is accepted; Apple/Google Pay; lost phone' best describes the customer's request?

criteria.card_not_working: The card is not working / stopped working in general (not specifically a declined payment, contactless, or ATM).
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted / can be used (shops, merchants, abroad), or a merchant not accepting the card.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment was declined/rejected at a shop or online.
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM swallowed / kept / ate the card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The card was lost or stolen, or found again after being lost.
criteria.compromised_card: The customer thinks their card or card details were stolen/copied or that someone else may be using the card, and asks what to do or how to report fraud - without pointing to a specific payment or withdrawal (those go to the not-recognised intents).
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The customer's phone was lost, stolen or left behind and they need access/security.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Any message that mentions Apple Pay, Google Pay or Apple Watch, whatever the issue: adding the card, paying, topping up with them, top-up via them failing (this wins over every top-up or card intent).

payments_charges.instructions: Which specific intent in the area 'Card payments and charges on the statement: pending, reverted, unrecognised, fees, wrong rate, duplicate, direct debits, refunds' best describes the customer's request?

criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is still pending.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted, returned or sent back to the account, or a merchant refused/returned the payment after it was made.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A specific payment or purchase on the statement the customer does not recognise, did not make, or says is wrong (even if they also suspect someone has their card).
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: A fee or extra charge for paying with the card / for a purchase; hidden fees or too many fees on payments; 'why was I charged extra' about using the card.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: A payment got the wrong exchange rate; a complaint that the rate the customer got/was applied is incorrect (not about cash withdrawals).
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same transaction/payment was charged twice (duplicate charge).
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: A small fixed extra charge such as an extra £1, $1 or €1 (one pound/dollar/euro) on the statement, even if pending or unrecognised.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer did not set up, or a vague charge the customer does not know or calls unknown/unauthorised ('I don't know what this charge is for', 'unauthorised charge').
criteria.request_refund: How to request/get a refund for a purchase, or wants to cancel a purchase / no longer wants an item.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund the customer is waiting for has not shown up in the account.

cash_atm.instructions: Which specific intent in the area 'Cash withdrawals and ATMs' best describes the customer's request?

criteria.atm_support: ATM questions: where to find an ATM, which ATMs accept the card, using the card at an ATM in general.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fees charged for withdrawing cash at an ATM.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A specific cash withdrawal on the account the customer did not make / does not recognise, even if they say someone has their card info or copied the card.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal at an ATM was declined/not authorised.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal shows as pending / in progress.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: An ATM gave the wrong amount of cash.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal.

top_up.instructions: Which specific intent in the area 'Topping up / adding money to the account' best describes the customer's request?

criteria.automatic_top_up: The automatic (auto) top-up feature: does it exist, how to set it up, how it works, its limits.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is pending or taking long to complete.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up by bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees for topping up by card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up with cash or a cheque; how to deposit cash/cheques.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed, was declined, gave an error, or something seems wrong with a top-up so the money is not accessible.
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-up amounts or frequency; maximum top-up.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted, or money from a top-up was taken but the account was not credited / the money disappeared.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up / add money using a card (debit or credit), or transferring money with a credit card.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verification of a top-up or top-up card; the verification code for a top-up.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Cash or cheque that was deposited is not showing in the balance yet / a cheque deposit is taking long.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into the account / add money by bank transfer.

transfers.instructions: Which specific intent in the area 'Bank transfers sent or received' best describes the customer's request?

criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: The customer was told by a message that a transfer is not possible or not allowed (to a particular person or account, or though it usually works), or cannot add or use a beneficiary/payee.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel, stop, reverse or revert a transfer or transaction they made, or sent money to the wrong account. (Cancelling a purchase from a merchant is request_refund.)
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was explicitly declined (a decline message), e.g. despite having enough money; also when the customer says their 'transfers' keep being declined/denied, even if they mention a purchase.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed, did not go through, keeps failing or gives an error; the customer cannot make a transfer or is unable to transfer funds.
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer is pending / still in progress.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee was charged on a transfer; also a bare 'why was I charged (a fee)?' asking the reason for a charge with no other context.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: A transfer the customer sent to someone (person, retailer, landlord) has not reached them yet, including asking how much longer the recipient must wait.
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money / can someone send me money, salary into the account.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: A bank transfer (incoming or outgoing) has gone through or was made but the account balance has not updated / the money is not showing in the balance.

currency.instructions: Which specific intent in the area 'Currencies, exchange, supported countries and cards' best describes the customer's request?

criteria.exchange_rate: What the exchange rates are, where to find them, how they are determined (a question, not a complaint about a wrong applied rate).
criteria.exchange_via_app: Whether and how the customer can exchange their money into another currency using the app (e.g. 'can I exchange some money to euros', 'change USD to GBP with the app').
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies are supported for holding or exchanging; whether a given currency (e.g. EUR) is supported or allowed.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, credit cards) or currencies can be used to top up / add money to the account.
criteria.country_support: Which countries the bank/service supports; whether people living in a given country or outside the UK can get the cards or use the service.

account.instructions: Which specific intent in the area 'Account, identity verification, personal details, passcode, age, closing account' best describes the customer's request?

criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open/use an account; can children or teenagers have an account.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Change personal details: name, address, phone, email, account information.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode / login code; reset passcode.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity; what documents are needed; how long verification takes.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification is needed, whether it is really necessary, or whether the account can be used without verifying; why personal information is requested.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification failed or cannot be completed.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying / showing the source of funds (where money came from).
